install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" ~/.agents/skills ~/.claude/skills; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; installed=false; base='https://github.com/bazf/trello-cli/releases/latest/download'; if curl -fsSL --max-time 20 "$base/trello-cli-linux-x64" -o "$tmp/trello-cli-linux-x64" && curl -fsSL --max-time 20 "$base/trello-cli-linux-x64.sha256" -o "$tmp/trello-cli-linux-x64.sha256"; then expected=$(awk '{print $1}' "$tmp/trello-cli-linux-x64.sha256"); actual=$(sha256sum "$tmp/trello-cli-linux-x64" | awk '{print $1}'); if [ -n "$expected" ] && [ "$expected" = "$actual" ]; then install -m 0755 "$tmp/trello-cli-linux-x64" "$HOME/.local/bin/trello-cli"; installed=true; fi; fi; if [ "$installed" != true ]; then dotnet restore src/TrelloCli.csproj --locked-mode --nologo; dotnet pack src/TrelloCli.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore --nologo; dotnet tool update --global --add-source src/nupkg TrelloCli; fi; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; ln -sfn "$PWD/plugins/trello-cli/skills/trello-cli" ~/.agents/skills/trello-cli; ln -sfn "$PWD/plugins/trello-cli/skills/trello-cli" ~/.claude/skills/trello-cli
